remarks: Tidy and Well-Kept Cape Cod on a Quiet South Buffalo Street! Welcome to 123 Kimmel, a charming Cape Cod offering a comfortable layout, versatile living space, and a fantastic list of recent updates. Set on a quiet South Buffalo street, this well-maintained home is ready to welcome its next owner. Covered front steps lead into a spacious living room featuring durable vinyl flooring and large windows that fill the space with wonderful natural light. The ample kitchen offers tile flooring, a gas range/oven, and considerable cabinet storage. Two first-floor bedrooms feature beautiful hardwood floors and generously sized closets. The hallway bathroom includes a tub/shower combination, additional storage, and an updated vanity. Upstairs, the fully finished second floor provides exceptional flexibility and can easily serve as a third bedroom, playroom, home office, or additional living space—whatever best suits your needs. The full basement provides abundant storage, while the backyard offers plenty of room to enjoy the outdoors. A storage shed, partially fenced yard, gorgeous willow tree, and established vegetable garden add to the home's appeal. Recent improvements include re-insulated and drywalled second-floor windows, a remodeled bedroom, refinished hardwood floors, new storm doors, a new electrical panel, and updated ceiling lighting. A wonderful opportunity to own a comfortable and thoughtfully updated home in South Buffalo. Seller reserves the right to set an offer deadline.
